summary.observation: Generation contributes most of the end-to-end latency.

improvement_recommendations.main_focus: Reduce generation latency and improve time to first token

recommendations.title: Use a faster or smaller LLM
recommendations.description: Use a faster model or a smaller model for simple questions to reduce generation time.

recommendations.title: Reduce maximum output tokens
recommendations.description: Limit the response length and instruct the model to provide concise answers without unnecessary repetition.
recommendations.example: Keep the answer within 150–250 words unless more detail is required.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Fewer generated tokens and faster responses

recommendations.title: Reduce prompt and context size
recommendations.description: Remove duplicate instructions, unnecessary conversation history, irrelevant text, and repeated document content.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Lower input processing time and faster first-token generation

recommendations.title: Reduce retrieved documents
recommendations.description: Test lower top_k and fetch_k values so that fewer document chunks are passed to the LLM.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Smaller context and lower retrieval and generation latency

recommendations.title: Enable streaming
recommendations.description: Enable token streaming so users can see the beginning of the answer earlier.
recommendations.note: Streaming improves perceived latency but may not reduce total answer generation time.

recommendations.title: Optimize document chunking
recommendations.description: Test smaller chunk sizes and lower overlap values to reduce the amount of context sent to the LLM.

recommendations.title: Optimize retrieval
recommendations.description: Reduce unnecessary reranking, optimize vector database search, and avoid retrieving irrelevant chunks.

recommendations.title: Add caching
recommendations.description: Cache repeated questions, embeddings, and frequently used retrieval results.

recommendations.title: Load models only once
recommendations.description: Initialize embedding models, vector stores, and LLMs during application startup instead of loading them for every request.

recommendations.title: Use GPU acceleration
recommendations.description: Use a supported GPU environment for embedding, reranking, and model inference when available.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Faster model inference and embedding operations

recommended_order: Use a faster or smaller LLM
Reduce prompt and retrieved context size

next_action.description: Apply the latency improvements and run the evaluation again.
